description: Closes #386 (Outlook agent_flow leg) — the Outlook specialist (#380/#382) had zero coverage. Mirrors 042 (Gmail): Composio is disabled in evals so the Outlook agent boots with zero tools; this case relies on the eval-stub OUTLOOK_LIST_MESSAGES tool (helixis.evals.connector_stub_tools) injected by the harness, with its _impl mocked to return a recent-inbox summary. Asserts the happy path: a 'recent emails' ask one-shots the fetch tool and the reply surfaces the messages. Quality/K-of-N assertions only — like 042, presenting inbox contents (including sender names) IS the job, so this does NOT assert reply_must_not_contain on a sender address (that would contradict the 042 precedent and false-positive on legitimate output). A PII-stripping guard is a hardening follow-up once a dogfood pass confirms the Outlook agent's echo behavior.

input.user_message: Show me my recent Outlook emails from tenants.

OUTLOOK_LIST_MESSAGES.return:

3. Building Front Desk <frontdesk@example.com> — "Package held for pickup" — Jul 6 — A package for Unit 11 is at the front desk.
